00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter l.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the l.
03-depart: We start on the green dot, at the bottom left. We go up on a slant, right to the top, and we turn left to make the big loop. Then we come straight back down, we cross the line, and we finish with a lovely curve resting on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with l.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with l.
